summary: Large enterprise RAG/on-prem code-search platform. Very sensitive to latency at rerank stage; heavy embedding churn (daily re-indexing). Evaluating Redwood Dedicated and Private for predictable throughput and VPC-first networking.
notes: Company background: 1.2k engineers, proprietary monorepo, strong internal search investment since 2020.
Primary product: internal developer search + security code audits (SCA-like workflows).
Current infra: self-hosted vector index (FAISS + custom sharding), ad-hoc reranker services on CPU for cross-encoder stage.
Why Redwood: interested in unified runtime (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and automatic batching/caching to reduce cost during peak commit windows.
Quote (CTO): 'We need reranks under 200ms 95p for dev UX; cost per query target ~$0.002-0.005 total.'
Index scale: estimates ~250M active vectors, archival ~1.1B vectors across languages + AST embeddings. Expect growth 2-3x Y/Y.
Reindex cadence: incremental daily + full weekly rebuilds for feature vectors (relearned embeddings), plus ad-hoc security sweeps.
Traffic pattern: heavy morning commit spikes (09:00-11:00 PT) and nightly batch jobs for CI; peak QPS target 3k qps with average 600 qps.
Latency targets: retrieval phase <70ms, reranker cross-encoder end-to-end <200ms (including network), tail p99 <400ms acceptable for background jobs.
Cost sensitivity: procurement pushing to cap hosting OPEX; will trade accuracy for quantization if unit economics improve (~30% cheaper).

Model preferences: open models acceptable (Llama2-13B / 70B quantized) for reranker, embedding model either open or in-house distilled embedder. Looking at mixed routing to smaller models for low-latency paths.
Routing/fallback: want auto-fallback to smaller, cheaper reranker if dedicated pool overloaded; explicit policy for security-critical queries to stay on private capacity.
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML + SCIM is must, strict audit logs retention 7+ years for security queries, KMS HSM for root keys, ability to run private control plane in their VPC.
Recent activity: 2026-02-25 deep-dive POC kickoff (fireflies ff_2026_02_25_9921) — infra team + SE present. Ran small 5M vector ingest test (latency baseline collected).
Proof-of-concept: POC scope agreed: ingestion pipeline, daily incremental updates, rerank latency SLA, cost per qps estimate, and SSO integration. POC success criteria documented in drive doc.
Technical concerns raised: how Redwood handles frequent KV cache invalidation during reindex, compaction strategy for vector stores, and model warmup time for quantized LLMs.
Action items: Redwood SE to provide dedicated pool sizing recommendation + estimated #GPUs for 3k qps with 200ms rerank SLA; provide demo of SAML flow with customer IdP.
Sales notes: AE to loop in enterprise legal for SLA negotiation; procurement expects ELA template by next month.
Customer quotes on cost: 'If we can't hit <$0.005/query we need to keep current hybrid architecture.'
On success: likely 3-year committed Dedicated contract + optional Private control plane for regulated repos (security team's ask).
